datasheet_identity.title: MM1W3V3 THRU MM1W330 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: Multi-part datasheet MM1W3V3-MM1W330; MM1W15 row (type code FHZ): VZ 13.8/15/15.8 V at IZT = 17 mA; ZZT = 14 ohm maximum at IZT; IR = 5 uA at VR = 11 V; admissible zener current IZM = 63 mA.
This datasheet publishes no ZZK/IZK knee-impedance column, so zener knee sharpness has no independent input (NBV would be held at its default downstream).
PD = 1000 mW at Tc = 75 degC, RthJA = 375 degC/W, Tj/Tstg -55 to +150 degC (p. 1 maximum ratings).
No junction/diode capacitance is published anywhere in the datasheet (table or figure).
No reverse recovery or switching time is published.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable electrical curves: the only figures are Fig.1 power derating vs ambient temperature and Fig.2 typical transient thermal impedance (p. 3), both family-level thermal plots. The datasheet contains no zener IV, forward IV, leakage, or capacitance characteristic curves, so no curve points could be digitized.
